Powersets.name: Thugs
Powersets.desc: Call in a gang of street thugs and enforcers to beat down your enemies.

powers.name: Call Thugs
powers.desc: Summon 1 to 3 Thugs depending on your level.

powers.name: Equip Thugs
powers.desc: Equip your thugs with better weapons and gear.

powers.name: Call Enforcer
powers.desc: Summon 1 or 2 Enforcers depending on your level.

powers.name: Upgrade Thugs
powers.desc: Provide your thugs with heavy weapons and advanced tactics.
